# reuters.com

reuters.com
India issues notice to Telegram, Signal on concerns over usernames, source says
Reuters
2-3 分鐘
Illustration shows Telegram app logo
Telegram app logo is seen in this illustration taken June 19, 2026.

REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration Purchase Licensing Rights, opens new tab
July 3 (Reuters) - India has issued notices to messaging platforms Telegram and Signal asking them to ​explain safeguards around features that allow users to post ‌messages without revealing their phone numbers, a government source said.

The notices mark a further escalation of India's policing of online platforms, from blocking an ​entire app, when it temporarily blocked Telegram last month, to vetting ​individual product features across multiple services.Get the latest news from India and how it matters to the world with the Reuters India File newsletter.Sign up here.

Telegram and Signal were ⁠asked on Thursday to detail how they protect users from ​impersonation and misuse enabled by features that let people interact without ​revealing phone numbers, the source said, speaking on condition of anonymity.India's IT ministry, Telegram and Signal did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

On Wednesday, ​India's IT ministry directed WhatsApp to freeze the rollout of its ​own planned username feature and justify it within three days or face regulatory ‌action, ⁠according to a government letter.India says that anonymity granted by usernames could increase online fraud, phishing, digital arrest scams and impersonation attacks.Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government has clashed repeatedly with global tech ​platforms.

It locked ​horns with Elon Musk's ⁠X over content-takedown orders and tightened rules in February requiring platforms to remove government-flagged content within three ​hours, down from 36 previously.The Internet Freedom Foundation, ​a digital ⁠rights group, called on the IT ministry to withdraw all three notices, saying the notice to Signal, an encrypted messenger used by ⁠journalists ​and activists, struck directly at protected speech."This ​is a dragnet, it is widening, and it has no basis in law".

Reporting by ​Rajesh Kumar, Munsif Vengattil, and Kashish Tandon;Editing by Raju Gopalakrishnan

reuters.com
India issues notice to Telegram, Signal on concerns over usernames, source says
Reuters
2-3 分鐘
Illustration shows Telegram app logo
Telegram app logo is seen in this illustration taken June 19, 2026. REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration Purchase Licensing Rights, opens new tab
July 3 (Reuters) - India has issued notices to messaging platforms Telegram and Signal asking them to ​explain safeguards around features that allow users to post ‌messages without revealing their phone numbers, a government source said.
The notices mark a further escalation of India's policing of online platforms, from blocking an ​entire app, when it temporarily blocked Telegram last month, to vetting ​individual product features across multiple services.
Get the latest news from India and how it matters to the world with the Reuters India File newsletter. Sign up here.
Telegram and Signal were ⁠asked on Thursday to detail how they protect users from ​impersonation and misuse enabled by features that let people interact without ​revealing phone numbers, the source said, speaking on condition of anonymity.
India's IT ministry, Telegram and Signal did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
On Wednesday, ​India's IT ministry directed WhatsApp to freeze the rollout of its ​own planned username feature and justify it within three days or face regulatory ‌action, ⁠according to a government letter.
India says that anonymity granted by usernames could increase online fraud, phishing, digital arrest scams and impersonation attacks.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government has clashed repeatedly with global tech ​platforms. It locked ​horns with Elon Musk's ⁠X over content-takedown orders and tightened rules in February requiring platforms to remove government-flagged content within three ​hours, down from 36 previously.
The Internet Freedom Foundation, ​a digital ⁠rights group, called on the IT ministry to withdraw all three notices, saying the notice to Signal, an encrypted messenger used by ⁠journalists ​and activists, struck directly at protected speech.
"This ​is a dragnet, it is widening, and it has no basis in law".
Reporting by ​Rajesh Kumar, Munsif Vengattil, and Kashish Tandon; Editing by Raju Gopalakrishnan

# reuters.com

reuters.com
印度就使用者名稱疑慮向 Telegram、Signal 發出通知，消息人士稱
路透社
2-3 分鐘
插圖顯示 Telegram 應用程式標誌
這張攝於 2026 年 6 月 19 日的插圖中可見 Telegram 應用程式標誌。

路透社／Dado Ruvic／插圖 購買授權，另開新分頁
7 月 3 日（路透社）——一名政府消息人士表示，印度已向通訊平台 Telegram 和 Signal 發出通知，要求它們說明針對允許使用者在不揭露電話號碼的情況下發布訊息的功能，採取了哪些防護措施。

這些通知標誌著印度對線上平台的監管進一步升高：從上個月暫時封鎖 Telegram 時封鎖整個應用程式，擴大到審查多個服務中的個別產品功能。透過 Reuters India File 電子報掌握印度最新消息及其對全球的重要性。點此訂閱。

該名因未獲授權公開發言而要求匿名的消息人士說，Telegram 和 Signal 週四被要求詳細說明，它們如何保護使用者免於因可讓人們在不揭露電話號碼下互動的功能，而遭遇冒名與濫用。印度資訊科技部、Telegram 和 Signal 未立即回應置評請求。

根據一封政府信函，印度資訊科技部週三指示 WhatsApp 暫停推出其自家規劃中的使用者名稱功能，並在三天內提出說明，否則將面臨監管行動。印度表示，使用者名稱帶來的匿名性可能增加線上詐欺、網路釣魚、「數位逮捕」詐騙與冒名攻擊。總理納倫德拉・莫迪（Narendra Modi）政府已多次與全球科技平台發生衝突。

印度政府曾與伊隆・馬斯克（Elon Musk）的 X 因內容下架命令交鋒，並在 2 月收緊規定，要求平台在三小時內移除政府標記的內容，短於先前的 36 小時。數位權利團體 Internet Freedom Foundation 呼籲資訊科技部撤回全部三項通知，並表示發給 Signal 的通知直接衝擊受保護言論；Signal 是一款加密通訊軟體，為記者與倡議人士所使用。「這是一張大網，正在擴大，而且沒有法律依據。」

Rajesh Kumar、Munsif Vengattil 與 Kashish Tandon 採訪報導；Raju Gopalakrishnan 編輯
我們的準則：Thomson Reuters Trust Principles，另開新分頁。

# 印度因使用者名稱疑慮向 Telegram、Signal 發出通知

reuters.com
印度就使用者名稱疑慮向 Telegram、Signal 發出通知，消息人士稱
路透社
2-3 分鐘
插圖顯示 Telegram 應用程式標誌
這張攝於 2026 年 6 月 19 日的插圖中可見 Telegram 應用程式標誌。

路透社／Dado Ruvic／插圖 購買授權，另開新分頁
7 月 3 日（路透社）——一名政府消息人士表示，印度已向通訊平台 Telegram 和 Signal 發出通知，要求它們說明針對允許使用者在不揭露電話號碼的情況下發布訊息的功能，採取了哪些防護措施。

這些通知標誌著印度對線上平台的監管進一步升高：從上個月暫時封鎖 Telegram 時封鎖整個應用程式，擴大到審查多個服務中的個別產品功能。透過 Reuters India File 電子報掌握印度最新消息及其對全球的重要性。點此訂閱。

該名因未獲授權公開發言而要求匿名的消息人士說，Telegram 和 Signal 週四被要求詳細說明，它們如何保護使用者免於因可讓人們在不揭露電話號碼下互動的功能，而遭遇冒名與濫用。印度資訊科技部、Telegram 和 Signal 未立即回應置評請求。

根據一封政府信函，印度資訊科技部週三指示 WhatsApp 暫停推出其自家規劃中的使用者名稱功能，並在三天內提出說明，否則將面臨監管行動。印度表示，使用者名稱帶來的匿名性可能增加線上詐欺、網路釣魚、「數位逮捕」詐騙與冒名攻擊。總理納倫德拉・莫迪（Narendra Modi）政府已多次與全球科技平台發生衝突。

印度政府曾與伊隆・馬斯克（Elon Musk）的 X 因內容下架命令交鋒，並在 2 月收緊規定，要求平台在三小時內移除政府標記的內容，短於先前的 36 小時。數位權利團體 Internet Freedom Foundation 呼籲資訊科技部撤回全部三項通知，並表示發給 Signal 的通知直接衝擊受保護言論；Signal 是一款加密通訊軟體，為記者與倡議人士所使用。「這是一張大網，正在擴大，而且沒有法律依據。」

Rajesh Kumar、Munsif Vengattil 與 Kashish Tandon 採訪報導；Raju Gopalakrishnan 編輯
我們的準則：Thomson Reuters Trust Principles，另開新分頁。
